name: Journal OnCommit Trigger
purpose: Journal Entry commit trigger: flags the entry for sending to QuickBooks (qbo_send = True) and recalculates total debits and total credits from the line items.
writes:
JournalEntry::qbo_send#5 (step 3, current record)
JournalEntry::totalAmt_debits#8 (step 7, current record)
JournalEntry::totalAmt_credits#6 (step 8, current record)
open_question: A debits = credits balance check is not in this script; if one exists it is elsewhere.

name: Clear Amount (type)
purpose: Enforces "either a debit or a credit amount per journal line": clears the debit amount or the credit amount according to the parameter (called on exit from the other amount).
writes:
JournalEntryItem::amount_debit#5 (step 8, current record, cleared)
JournalEntryItem::amount_credit#11 (step 10, current record, cleared)
open_question: Per the comment this is attached as an OnObjectExit trigger on each amount field; the trigger attachments are in the layout explorer.
